# Damodaran Online Archive

Local archive of Damodaran's website (pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/) — datasets, course materials, research papers, Excel tools, and book companions — converted to Claude-readable markdown.

**Status: build phase.** Content has not been crawled yet. The full crawl and conversion runs on a GPU machine following the runbook below. Once built, this `CLAUDE.md` is regenerated by `scripts/build-damodaran-index.py` with a full doc index and a `content-index.yaml` pointer.

## Doc Index

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [crawl-and-conversion-runbook.md](crawl-and-conversion-runbook.md) | Self-contained runbook: phases, script specs, scale gates, and conventions for building this archive. Start here. |

## Notes for future sessions

- Blog posts are NOT archived here — they live in [`../03-4-blogs/posts/`](../03-4-blogs/posts/) (~680 posts)
- Videos are never downloaded — stub `.md` files with external URLs only
